description: This source file provides functions for injecting JavaScript into a WebKit browser frame, specifically adding a 'Milestone' object with an associated function for automation purposes. It includes external references to WebKit and JavaScriptCore APIs, and defines functions used to facilitate JavaScript injection within the WebKit framework.

methods.name: automationMilestone
methods.description: A callback function that logs three string arguments, used as a JavaScript function handler for automation purposes.

methods.name: InjectJS
methods.description: Injects a 'Milestone' object with an associated function into the JavaScript context of the main frame in a WebKit browser, enabling JavaScript to call native automation functionality.
